independence: three distinct actual reviewers, including target-culture familiarity, no model substitute
blindness: randomized candidate IDs; no model, seed or automatic/assistant quality labels; original and target intent shown
open_questions: identify target object without being told its name first
major factual or culturally inappropriate issue?
pass_rule: no critical preservation failure; target recognizable; at least 2 of 3 reviewers score ALL four dimensions >=4; no unresolved major factual/cultural objection
rubric_origin: project-specific pilot criterion, not published benchmark standard
pilot_gate: Do not expand to six cases before first-case technical and visual feasibility and genuine initial-case acceptance are established.
